problem_statement: Several message operations (setting a length, appending bytes, copying a range from another message, and writing at an offset) compute a sum of an existing length/offset and a requested length without checking whether the sum overflows the integer type. When the two operands sum past the maximum representable value, the wraparound produces an incorrect size, allowing a too-small allocation or a parse of an out-of-range range. The stack needs to detect such overflowing additions and reject the request instead of proceeding with a wrapped value.
